capabilities: Publish or update notes as Leaflet documents on your AT Protocol repository (PDS)
Publish whole folders or all notes marked with a publish property, after confirmation
Manage Leaflet posts in a list view: search, filter, relink to notes, republish, delete
Convert Obsidian Markdown (callouts, embeds, Dataview queries, Excalidraw, math, footnotes) to Leaflet content
Apply ordered regex text-replacement rules and per-note properties (slug, cover, publication) before publishing
disambiguation: Not a general static-site or blog publisher; it only publishes to Leaflet publications on the AT Protocol.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it can also be installed via BRAT or from release files. The README includes a privacy section listing exactly which services are contacted.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish notes as AT Protocol records to a Leaflet publication on the user's own PDS.

relations.evidence: Publish your notes to Leaflet (leaflet.pub), the AT Protocol blogging platform.
Create an app password in Bluesky: Settings → Privacy and security → App passwords.
Dataview, Excalidraw and embed conversion come from Enveloppe
Dataview queries (DQL, DataviewJS, inline) | Replaced by their result in Markdown (requires Dataview)

summary: Publishing plugin that sends Obsidian notes to Leaflet (leaflet.pub) as AT Protocol records, with multi-publication support and a post manager.
